observations: The first official document exposes the maps-docs-team iframe. Its page title loaded but the rendered DOM contained no location input, only an unpopulated GMP-MAP and hidden info window.

The second official document linked the geo-devrel sample. Its IAB DOM and accessibility tree showed only a map region and iframe, with no location input. A newly created visible IAB tab had the same result.
No hotel name could be submitted in either actual UI; no Place ID was observed. The technical cause was not diagnosed.
decision: Keep all three hotel products pending despite newly available CC0 coordinate evidence. No Google coordinates or inferred IDs are stored.
